itemText: Accept up to 5 optional accent phrases (200 characters each) when a knowledge source is added, store them on the source, and include them in the English card-generation prompt as untrusted data.
On the web Add Knowledge form, show an accent phrases group (one input, add and remove more) only for the English subject and its sub-subjects, and send the filled phrases with the source.
On iPhone and Mac Add Knowledge, show the same accent phrases group for English subjects and send the filled phrases with the source.
